chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Armstrong's records and Mosley's one-nighters
summary: Driggs sorts out which records Mosley made with Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I'm going to send you a list of all the records that Louie made from the time that we think he joined and to the time we think he left, we may find some others. A lot of that time when you were with him, he wasn't recording, he wasn't using his own band. Decca had him recording

with the Mills Brothers who was a small group and they had him recording with Andy Iona, they had him recording with Jimmy Dorsey's band; a lot of times he was not using his own band. You made all your records with him, clustered in a little bunch. I thought when you joined him I thought that he was still (inaudible), but I guess he wasn't.
You were just doing theatres and one nighters.
I did a lot of one nighters, all the way across the country.
There's a tour that Leonard Fether went on the bus with at one point; I thought that was in '36, that should have been the time that you were in the band.
Maybe that's where I met Leonard; could be.
